Security.title: Security
Security.accountOnlyBody: These settings are for accounts with an email and password. Demo profiles don’t have them.
Security.devicesSub: Where your account is signed in right now.
Security.logoutAllBody: You will be signed out here too and will need to sign in again.
Security.passwordSub: Choose a new password. Your other devices will be signed out.
Security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
Security.mfaSub: Ask for a six-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
Security.mfaUnavailable: Two-factor sign-in isn’t available right now. The server needs a SESSION_SECRET to turn it on.
Security.mfaStep1: Add this key to your authenticator app, or open the app with the button below.
Security.mfaStep2: Then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
Security.mfaOffBody: Enter a current code and your password.
Security.codeHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
Security.mfaLoginSub: Your account asks for a second step.
Security.errMfaInvalid: That code didn’t work. Try the current one.
Security.errResetLink: This link no longer works. Request a new one.
Security.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
Security.errAccountRequired: Only accounts with an email and password can do this.
Security.errValidation: Check what you entered and try again.
Security.errOffline: Couldn’t reach Faroz. Try again in a minute.
Security.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

PasswordReset.forgotSub: Enter your account email and we’ll send you a link.
PasswordReset.sent: If an account exists for this email, we’ve sent a link.
PasswordReset.devNote: In this local build no email is sent: the link appears in the server log.
PasswordReset.doneBody: Your password is updated and your devices were signed out. Sign in with the new one.
PasswordReset.invalidBody: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
